new_today_news.headline: Global Bio-Based Sustainable Aviation Fuel (Bio-SAF) Market Size, Share, Trends, and Forecast to 2036
new_today_news.summary: Market research report reveals used cooking oil is projected to represent 57.1% of the bio-SAF market by feedstock in 2026, with global bio-SAF valued at USD 3.95 billion in 2025 and estimated at USD 4.99 billion in 2026. HEFA-SPK pathway is expected to account for 84.6% of global bio-SAF production in 2026.

new_today_news.headline: Generation, Management and Characteristics of Grease Trap Solid Waste from Malaysian Food Premises
new_today_news.source: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health (Springer)
new_today_news.summary: Research paper published today on grease trap solid waste generation and management from food service operations. Study examines waste composition and disposal practices, with implications for circular economy and resource-recovery strategies.

recent_news.headline: India's First Commercial-Scale Sustainable Aviation Fuel Plant Produces First Batch
recent_news.summary: Indian Oil's Panipat facility produced its first SAF batch on November 16, 2026, using used cooking oil as feedstock with an annual capacity of 30,000 tonnes. The facility received Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) approvals for commercial supply.
